title: Maximum Likelihood from Incomplete Data Via the EM Algorithm
summary: A. P. Dempster, N. M. Laird, and D. B. Rubin published "Maximum Likelihood from Incomplete Data Via the EM Algorithm" in the Journal of the Royal Statistical Society: Series B in 1977. The paper presents a broadly applicable algorithm for computing maximum-likelihood estimates from incomplete data and derives monotonic-likelihood and convergence results.
significance: A documented statistical-computation and machine-learning milestone for the expectation-maximization algorithm, preserved at publication-year precision while keeping the earlier 1976 Royal Statistical Society presentation distinct from the 1977 journal publication.

verification.note: Wiley's journal record identifies the 1977 publication, authors, journal placement, volume 39 issue 1, pages 1-22, DOI 10.1111/j.2517-6161.1977.tb01600.x, and the paper's broadly applicable maximum-likelihood algorithm for incomplete data. Harvard DASH separately records that the work was presented to the Royal Statistical Society on 8 December 1976. LINEAiGE therefore records the 1977 journal-publication milestone at year precision and does not convert the 1976 presentation into the publication date or infer a universal invention date, geography, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationship edge.
